eval_criteria.label: Authenticity
eval_criteria.description: Does the matched archetype genuinely fit this user's physical and personal profile?

eval_criteria.label: Personalization
eval_criteria.description: Does the narrative feel written for this specific user, incorporating their actual interview answers?

eval_criteria.label: Pathway Distinctness
eval_criteria.description: Are the standing and adaptive pathways meaningfully different from each other in athletic angle and narrative?

eval_criteria.label: Life Stage Coherence
eval_criteria.description: Does the archetype and narrative language fit the user's age at the destination Games? Scored only when time travel is active.

eval_criteria.label: Interview Quality
eval_criteria.description: Did the Narrator ask questions that genuinely differentiated this user's athletic potential? Options must represent real forks.

eval_criteria.label: Compliance Quality
eval_criteria.description: No forbidden terms used, no NIL violations, equal narrative depth for standing and adaptive pathways.
